So, over the years I have made it a point to keep my files and folders as organized as I can and delete as little as possible. I still have all the frames from hours worth of imaging that never stacked correctly, or just didn't work because of wind or what not. It's grown to a little over 1.5Tb and starting to spill out onto my other drives. I really don't want to delete anything but 10, 000 @ ~15mb an image for one night is a little overkill to keep.

How I have it at the moment is /Astrophotography/OBJECTNAME/DATE/FILES.WHATEVER

I have started to write a little program that will go through and compress (Not sure what I'm going to use yet, likely just zip) ONLY the frames of the set and not the stacked images and hopefully then it will find the stacked images and rename them correctly for me.

This should save me a lot of space but as I was working on the idea I figure there has to be better ways to organizing all the thousands and thousands of images you get over time.
